_doc: THE SHEETS -- one source for the cover generator (print/cover/make_cover.ps1) and the print-score assembly, so the cover is drawn at exactly the sheet the score prints on. w x h in `unit` (mm or in), landscape. Same shape as septet_LGMF_2026/print/formats.json, where the generator comes from.
_score: THE QUARTET'S SHEET IS THE CAPTURED SCREEN: scripts/generate_print_pdf.js prints the performance app at 1600 x 1200 px, which Chrome writes as a 1200 x 900 pt MediaBox = 16.667 x 12.5 in, landscape 4:3 (measured off builds/print/full_score.pdf, 2026-10-08). The cover and the instructions are drawn at that sheet so every page of the PDF is one size.

score-landscape.label: Score sheet, landscape 4:3 (1200 x 900 pt = 16.667 x 12.5 in)
